title: John Riggins 2023 Panini Prizm Washington Redskins #297 NFL
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Prizm sports trading card features John Riggins of the Washington Redskins/Washington Commanders. The card is made of card stock, has a standard size, and is an original release from the manufacturer, Panini. It is part of the base set and has a Prizm parallel/variety. The card number is 297 and it is from the 2023 season. 

The front of the card showcases Riggins in his football gear, and the back includes information about his career and stats. This card is perfect for any collector or fan of the NFL and John Riggins.
